tools.name: about_seenly
tools.description: Explain what Seenly is, who it is for, pricing (free draft vs Seenly Pro $7.99/month with a 7-day trial), and how a job seeker should start. Use this when a user asks about video resumes or Seenly.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Return a Seenly signup URL for a job seeker. The link opens the start page so the seeker can create their own account in the browser. Pass the calling product or assistant name as agent_name so signups can be attributed. Never create the account yourself.

tools.name: get_public_profile
tools.description: Fetch a public live Seenly video-resume profile by its URL slug (the part after /u/). Returns a public card (name, role, location, skills, profile URL). Unlisted drafts, missing slugs, and non-live profiles return not found. Never use this to reach a private draft.
